sourceSummary.zh: 官方网站把神奇公式落实为筛选、分散、持有与更新组合的流程。
sourceSummary.en: The official page turns screening into a diversified holding and renewal process.

heading.en: A list still needs a portfolio process

paragraphs.zh: 官网先让使用者选择公司规模与股票数量。这一步是在确定机会范围与分散程度，并没有要求把榜首的一家公司押成全部仓位。阅读这个流程时，值得把筛选结果理解为一组待执行的机会，而不是对某只股票的确定判断。
paragraphs.en: The size and stock-count choices define the universe and diversification. A highly ranked name is part of a portfolio procedure rather than a reason to concentrate everything in a single company.

heading.zh: 执行成本也在方法之内

paragraphs.zh: 官方说明把交易成本和分批购入放进同一流程。导读认为，分批的作用是让实施方式与资金规模相匹配，避免把所有结果压在一个买入时刻；它与预测短期涨跌是不同的问题。
paragraphs.en: Costs and staged purchases are implementation choices. The guide reads staging as a way to organize deployment over time, rather than an attempt to predict the next market move.

heading.zh: 持有规则必须配合更新规则

paragraphs.zh: 官网随后讨论约一年的持有期，以及出售后重新筛选组合。这提示读者，神奇公式并不是选出一批股票后永久不变。对自己的记录而言，除了保存买入时的筛选依据，也应记录何时重新核算、哪些项目发生变化，以及变化是否改变排名。
paragraphs.en: The holding period is followed by another screening round. A useful research record therefore preserves the initial inputs and subsequent recalculations instead of treating the first selection as permanent.

heading.zh: 把执行说明与财报计算分开核对
heading.en: Check implementation and accounting inputs separately

paragraphs.zh: 这篇说明解决的是怎样把筛选变成组合，没有逐项拆解企业的现金、债务和经营资本。要复核自己的神奇公式数值，仍应回到财报中的计算项目；组合执行规则与财务口径，是需要分别检查的两部分。
paragraphs.en: This page explains execution, not line-by-line accounting adjustments. A personal formula calculation still needs financial-statement checks for cash, debt and operating capital alongside a separate implementation plan.
